headline: Nigeria International LNG Supply Rises 30% on Higher Feedgas
summary: Nigeria's international liquefied natural gas deliveries rose by 30 percent between January and October, driven by higher feedgas availability, according to the IEA.
why: Increased LNG export volumes affect global gas balances and national export revenues for major African producers.
why_moved: Higher feedgas availability enabled a 30 percent rise in international liquefied natural gas deliveries.
